facts.journal: Clinical Implant Dentistry and Related Research
facts.population: 36 fully edentulous patients with extreme maxillary alveolar resorption, after maxillary bone augmentation and 4-6 implants
facts.main_result: 3D-IODs improved OHIP-20 by 0.26 points more than C-IODs (p<0.001) and VAS satisfaction by 7.37 points (p<0.001); SF-36 only emotional wellbeing better (p=0.033).
facts.follow_up: 1 year per prosthesis type (2 years total)
materials_brands: Nobel Parallel Conical Connection implants (Nobel Biocare)
facts.key_finding: In a randomized crossover trial of 36 edentulous patients, fully digital implant overdentures gave significantly better OHIP-20 and satisfaction scores than conventional ones, with little difference in general health.
facts.clinical_bottom_line: A fully digital workflow for implant overdentures gave better patient-reported outcomes than the conventional one in this trial.
